summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed for all three requested fixes. At 375x667, the secretary dashboard remained 375px wide, its tab list had overflow-x:auto (341px client width vs 496px scroll width), scrolled horizontally, and the RH tab remained clickable. The employee modal showed 0% Utilisation with a 0%-wide/empty gauge. The unauthenticated beginner test issued GET /api/pricing, gated after five answers, and displayed the live prices 30€, 76€, 90€, and 102€ instead of stale defaults.

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting an answer logs a controlled/uncontrolled RadioGroup warning on every question. The tested answer and gate flow still works.

action_items: Initialize the TestPage RadioGroup with a stable controlled value to remove the repeated React warning.
For robustness, use nullish fallback for pricing fields and clamp gauge percentages to both 0 and 100.
critical_code_review_comments: TestPage maps API prices with `value || default`; use `value ?? default` so a legitimate numeric zero from /api/pricing is not replaced by a hardcoded price.
SecretaryHR clamps utilization width only at the upper bound. Use Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 - pct)) to prevent invalid negative percentages if source data is temporarily inconsistent.
SecretaryDashboard.js remains substantially above the 700-line maintainability threshold and should be split into feature-focused components in a separate refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the 3 requested regressions (3/3 passed); one unrelated low-priority React console warning remains

seed_data_creation: None; used existing level-test questions, live pricing, existing RH employee data, and the supplied secretary account.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and authenticated through /login with the supplied secretary email/password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three iteration-12 fixes passed. Mobile tab metrics at 375px: document 375/375 client/scroll width; tab list 341/496 with max horizontal scroll 155px. First employee profile displayed Utilisation 0%, inline gauge width 0%, and rendered ratio 0%. TestPage observed GET /api/pricing 200 and the Q5 gate matched live EUR values kkid=30, beginner=76, intermediate=90, advanced=102. An initial Playwright attempt could not read a captured response body due to a DevTools protocol limitation; the corrected rerun compared UI against a direct same-origin fetch and passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The requested fixes are effective: overflow is contained on the TabsList rather than the document; modal gauge width now uses the same utilization calculation as its label; TestPage fetches /api/pricing and updates pack state before the Q5 gate. The remaining RadioGroup warning occurs because its value is undefined/null before selection and becomes a string after selection, changing control mode.
